_comment: The space suit (r41, #50, #311), after Barotrauma's diving suit (divinggear.xml:135, PressureProtection 4000). It is worn in its own place, never in a bar slot (F on it in the world puts it on, a click in a locker too). Worn: no vacuum damage (crates/health_core/src/vacuum.rs). It holds ONE air canister: this item's condition is that canister's fill (0..100 %, no condition: no canister), so the canister travels with the suit into a locker. The body breathes from it at the mask's rates (crates/health_core/src/mask.rs). TODO(initiator): shape, mass, colour, the helmet's look, the suit's protection against the abyss suit's 6650.
name: Space Suit
